messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: did a quick pass on audit event coverage while prepping for the compliance review. Noticed inconsistent fields + missing events across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Need a short triage and backlog plan.
Tom Becker: thanks Priya. can you paste one example of the inconsistencies?
Priya Nair: sure — e.g. API gateway emits `request_id` and `method`, but no `actor` when token is service-account. Auth service emits `actor` but no `resource_version` on RBAC changes. Console emits UI click events with only `user_id` and `page`, missing `outcome` and `ip`. Billing has invoice events but no `request_id` correlation. runtime logs model loads but missing `kms_key_id` on key rotation.
Morgan Lee: rough priority: for compliance we must ensure tamper-evident, correlated request ids and key rotation evidence. I'd prioritize: 1) RBAC change events (auth + console) 2) KMS rotate events (runtime + billing) 3) request_id propagation (api gateway + billing)
Alice Chen: agree. For RBAC: schema v2 should include `event_id`, `timestamp`, `actor{type,id}`, `action`, `target{type,id}`, `outcome`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, `resource_version`. We should publish the schema and a shim library.
Ravi Patel: +1 for a shim. Is there a preferred format — JSON Lines or protobuf? protobuf could be compact but harder for external customers. JSON Lines with a schema registry (avro/JSON schema) seems easiest for compatibility.
Priya Nair: customers expect readable audit logs for evidence; go with JSON Lines + JSON Schema. We'll add an ephemeral mapping doc for SDKs.
Tom Becker: technical note: api-gateway mutates headers on some LB hops. We'll need to propagate `x-request-id` and add `x-audit-request-id` to avoid collisions. I'll own request-id propagation.
Morgan Lee: Tom, can you include a small non-breaking header naming plan and a fallback (use trace_id if request_id absent)?
Tom Becker: yep. plan: prefer `x-audit-request-id`, fallback to `x-trace-id`, generate if neither. I'll open PR for gateway and LB filter.
Alice Chen: about KMS: runtime should emit `kms_event` with `kms_key_id`, `action` (rotate/disable), `actor`, and `artifact_hash` for model encryption keys. Billing must record `kms_key_id` when a customer requests export or snapshot.
Priya Nair: we also need to ensure logs are immutable and ship to central audit pipeline with signature/hmac. Can security infra verify HMAC using KMS-derived keys? DevSecBot: automated check: HMAC via KMS-signing is supported in pipeline v1.2; however, signing is currently optional and only enabled for hosted accounts.
Ravi Patel: then we must rollout signing to Dedicated/Private customers or at least provide instructions for HSM/KMS bootstrap. I'll draft the ops runbook.
Alice Chen: schema change impact: we'll need consumers to handle missing fields gracefully. propose versioned field names: e.g., `actor_v2` for expanded actor object and retain `actor` for a transition period.
Priya Nair: good call. Also need customer-facing validation: a small validator that customers can run on their exports to assert required fields for SOC/ISO audits. We'll add an open-source `redwood-audit-validator`.
Tom Becker: rough timeline? can we do RBAC events + request-id propagation in 2 sprints?
Morgan Lee: 2 sprints for gateway + auth bootstrap seems doable if team prioritizes. KMS and billing coupling will need coordination with infra and billing owner — estimate 3-4 sprints for full end-to-end.
Priya Nair: action items: 1) Tom — PR for `x-audit-request-id` propagation + LB filter (due next Wed). 2) Alice — draft schema v2 and transitional mapping doc (due EoW). 3) Ravi — ops runbook for KMS/HSM signing and validator outline (due next Tue). 4) Morgan — create backlog epic and tag owners for billing/runtime integration. 5) Priya — customer validator repo scaffold and compliance note (due next Fri).
Tom Becker: assigning myself. I'll also link failing traces that show missing request_ids.
Alice Chen: I'll start schema doc in the security drive and post link here when ready.
Ravi Patel: starting runbook draft. Will include HSM KMS examples and mitigation for offline/private installs.
DevSecBot: reminder — opened issue #4227: "Audit schema v2 + validator" and epic #4310: "Audit coverage: api, auth, console, billing, runtime".
Priya Nair: tagging @Morgan Lee and @Alice Chen for visibility. Thanks team — let's sync weekly until compliance review. :thumbsup:
Morgan Lee: +1. moving to backlog and will ping owners in the epic.
